## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover behavior and regressions.
- [ ] Formatting, linting, type checks, and relevant builds pass.
- [ ] OpenAPI/examples/docs match public behavior.
- [ ] Migration rollback/backup implications are documented.
- [ ] Scoring changes are versioned and explained.
- [ ] Demo mode remains visibly labeled and network-isolated.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, raw IPs, or production credentials are present.
- [ ] Accessibility, mobile, performance, and security were considered.
